records.source_statement: Subsection asks from what part a person shall marry.
Seventh lord in ninth implies marriage to a stranger.
First and seventh lords in same quarter, house or sign suggest a partner from nearby.
limitations: Alternative proximity indications, not a distance.

records.source_statement: Seventh-lord sign and predominant quarter testimonies suggest a compass direction, with sign preferred to quarter.
Moon with Venus is used to claim sought partner has agreeable traits.
Moon with Mars suggests painful traits; Sun relating to Jupiter suggests more honest/pleasant disposition.
Sun and Moon in square or opposition are said to indicate contention and separation.
limitations: Requires specific bodies and hard aspect.
